name: Luce Choice Ratio
description: Synthetic experiment runner implementing the Shepard-Luce choice model for category selection based on similarity measures.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Number of allowed values for stimulus similarity variables.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Parameter measuring participant focus/attention (affects choice probability).

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame with four similarity measures as independent variables.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: DataFrame with choice probability (choose_A1) as dependent variable.
